services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: The Cole Land Transportation Museum’s mission of raising the aspirations of Maine children is supported through free educational programs, publications, and field trip experiences for teachers and schools. The museum is happy to welcome schools and organizations for interesting, exciting, and educational field trips led by knowledgeable staff and volunteers. Included resources: tours, student-veteran interview opportunities, in-class presentations, study guides, books, videos, and publications.
